title: Portrait
description: One person is close enough that the face is the picture. Keep the person sharp, and also a held object or the chair they are clearly sitting on. Lift the face, clarify the eyes, and soften whatever is behind them.
reason: The face is the subject, so it is lifted a little, the eyes are clarified, and the background is softened. A held object or the chair they are on can stay sharp with them.

features.person: The person stays sharp, with the face lifted and the eyes clarified.
features.held: An object the person is clearly holding stays sharp with them.
features.seat: The chair they are clearly sitting on stays sharp with them.
features.background: Whatever is behind the person falls soft.

subject.skip: Skip the face when no face or person is in the frame.

eyes.skip: Skip the eyes when no eye is found in the face.

skin.skip: Skip skin when the face has no skin tones to smooth.

sky.skip: Skip the sky. The sky is not a separate grade here.

background.skip: Skip the background when the face could not be isolated.

foreground.skip: Skip the foreground. The frame is handled by the global grade.
